Tooltip_MVR_FailBand: Failure risk: %1 (Mechanics 4 shows the exact chance)
Tooltip_MVR_Severe: A bad failure costs 20 condition; a minor one costs 5 and the materials.
Tooltip_MVR_Patches: Already patched %1 time(s): each patch lowers the cap by 3. Replace the part to reset.
Tooltip_MVR_VanillaAvailable: A standard repair is possible with what you carry (Repair menu). It is usually better.
Tooltip_MVR_VanillaExists: This part also has a standard repair (Repair menu).
Tooltip_MVR_Status_not_repairable: Bulbs cannot be patched: replace the part.
Tooltip_MVR_Status_above_cap: Already at or above what this repair can reach (%1).
Tooltip_MVR_Req_ShelterOrJack: Indoors (garage) or a jack in the inventory
Tooltip_MVR_Inspect: Check every part: condition, earlier patches, risk of the next patch and standard repairs you can do. Needs light.
Tooltip_MVR_InspectDark: Too dark to inspect. Get a light.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopBenefit: Original %1 -> selected %2 (at full condition; native damage penalties still apply).
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopCost: Requirements and costs are checked again when work finishes.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopRisk: No random failure. This work grants no XP.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopTime: Work time: %1 action units (before character speed modifiers).
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopPower: Power only: +5% / +10%. Quality and noise are preserved.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopCargo: Cargo: +10% / +20%, at most +40 capacity. Follows the physical part.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopGlove: Glove box: +25% / +50%, at most +5 capacity. Follows the physical part.
Tooltip_MVR_CosmeticOnly: Appearance only: paint and rust removal do not repair parts or add protection.
Tooltip_MVR_RustStep: Removes up to 20 percentage points of rust per application.
Tooltip_MVR_Wash: Uses the game's normal water-consuming vehicle washing action. Carry at least 1 unit of water and find blood to wash.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_ok: Ready. Work beside the selected part, on the same floor, with engine off and vehicle stopped.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_disabled: This operation is disabled by the server.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_not_installed: The selected part must be installed.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_unsupported: Only the game's generic engine, trunk and glove-box parts have supported upgrades. Special systems are excluded.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_unpaintable: This model does not enable native vehicle tinting.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_access: Unlock access using the vehicle key or the game's normal door/window access.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_already: The selected result is already installed, or there is nothing left to remove.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_overloaded: Unload cargo first. A downgrade cannot reduce capacity below the contents; damaged parts may require more unloading.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_conflict: Another system changed this part's base statistics. This upgrade is suspended to preserve that change.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_workshop: Tier II needs a sheltered vehicle and Mechanics 6.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_skill: Your Mechanics level is too low.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_missing_tools: A required tool is missing or broken.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_stale: The vehicle or installed part changed while you were working. Start again.
Tooltip_MVR_WorkshopStatus_work_area: Work beside the part, on the same floor, with the vehicle stopped and engine off.
Tooltip_MVR_Status_access: Unlock access using the vehicle key or the game's normal door/window access.
Tooltip_MVR_Status_destroyed: A destroyed window must be replaced.
Tooltip_MVR_HistoryRestoration: History restoration only: removes one patch penalty on success while preserving current condition.
